description: Vault blob v2 binary format: magic(4) + version(1) + key_epoch(4) + root_folder_key_len(2) + encrypted_root_folder_key(var) + root_ipns_name_len(2) + root_ipns_name(var)
note: Vault blob v2 schema stores ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey and root IPNS name in a compact binary format for IPFS storage
